name: Klotski State Space
description: Build your own sliding-block puzzle and watch its entire state space grow as a 3D network. Zoom in to see each state as a picture.

name: Three-Body Gravity
description: Place three glowing bodies in 3D space, give each its own gravity, and watch their orbits unfold with fading trails.

name: Fourier Drawing
description: Draw any shape and watch it rebuilt by rotating epicycles (a Discrete Fourier Transform visualised).

name: Game of Life Explorer
description: Cellular automata playground: draw patterns, stamp from a pattern library, and try rule variants (Life, HighLife, Seeds and more) at adjustable speed.

name: Inside a Tiny LLM
description: Watch a small transformer read a sentence and write an answer token by token, with its embeddings, attention and neurons shown live.

name: Sorting Algorithm Theatre
description: Twelve sorting algorithms race side by side on the same data as bars, colour wheels or sound, with live counts of compares and writes.
